basic_details.job_title: GIPMER Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Junior Resident Posts
basic_details.department: Cardiology, CTVS, G.I. Surgery, Biochemistry, Psychiatry

basic_details.short_information: Ten Junior Resident posts in Cardiology (4), CTVS (1), G.I. Surgery (2), Biochemistry (1) and Psychiatry (2) are to be filled purely on adhoc basis at the Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (GIPMER), Govt. of NCT of Delhi, at Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56100-Rs. 177500) plus usual allowances, for 44 days or till regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier. The application form (Annexure-I) must be submitted at 5th Floor, D-Block, Academic Cell, GIPMER on or before 30 November 2026 up to 04.00 P.M., and the interview will be held on 2 December 2026 at 12:00 Noon

application_fee.details: The fee is payable only by Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT, G.B. PANT HOSPITAL, payable at New Delhi. Candidates may also deposit the fee in cash with the Cashier at the Accounts Branch of the Institute. The notice does not mention any fee exemption.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 30 years (as on the closing date, i.e. 30/11/2026) for General/EWS category candidates. | OBC/EWS candidates from Delhi only are eligible and must submit a caste certificate issued by the competent authority of GNCT of Delhi, mentioning that they belong to the Non Creamy Layer for the current financial year. Candidates who have completed their internship within one year of the last date for submission of application are eligible. Applicants who have completed their internship one year or more before the last date of receiving applications will not be considered and need not apply. content_sections.heading: About GIPMER Junior Resident
content_sections.text: The Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (GIPMER) is an institute of the Government of NCT of Delhi located at 1, J.L. Nehru Marg, New Delhi-110002. This interview notice was issued by the Institute's Administration Branch with the prior approval of the Medical Director, GIPMER, and the posts are filled under the Residency Scheme of the Government of India.

rows.event: Last date for submission of application

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: GIPMER has advertised 10 Junior Resident posts across five departments. The notice states that the number of vacant posts is provisional and subject to change (may increase or decrease), and that the vacancies are likely to vary and may be filled in phases. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies. A waiting list of up to 20% of the advertised vacancies may be prepared.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Further eligibility conditions printed in the notice: Foreign Medical Graduates (FMGs) who have completed their internship outside India and have qualified the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) shall be considered eligible based on the date of declaration of the FMGE (date of passing FMGE), irrespective of the date of completion of internship. Candidates who have completed their internship within one year of the last date for submission of application are eligible. Applicants who have completed their internship one year or more before the last date of receiving applications will not be considered and need not apply. A valid DMC registration is required at the time of joining. Candidates who have applied and have a valid DMC acknowledgement receipt will be allowed for the interview. If selected, candidates should produce the DMC certificate with U.G. qualification before joining; those who have only applied for DMC registration shall not be taken on strength merely on production of the DMC fee receipt. Junior Residents who are presently working in GIPMER are not eligible to participate; their applications will not be considered and shall be treated as cancelled. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each department's post.

rows.qualification: MBBS [Equivalent Foreign Degree will be accepted only after passing the Screening test conducted by National Board of Examination (NBE)] with 01 year internship.
rows.experience: Experience certificate, if any, is to be enclosed with the application.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: The age limit is 30 years (as on the closing date, i.e. 30/11/2026) for General/EWS category candidates. OBC/EWS candidates from Delhi only are eligible and must submit a caste certificate issued by the competent authority of GNCT of Delhi, mentioning that they belong to the Non Creamy Layer for the current financial year. In case of non-availability of candidates, candidates may be considered under the relaxation provided in circular No.F.121/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045, dated 10.06.2011, issued by the Health & Family Welfare Department, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, under which the upper age limit for eligibility will be 40 years in place of 30 years.

rows.category: Qualified Ex-Service personnel with continuous service of not less than 5 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Junior Residents will get Pay level 10 (Rs. 56100-Rs. 177500/-) plus usual allowances as per rules/residency rules. The appointment and services will be governed under the Residency Scheme of Govt. of India. The appointment is purely on adhoc basis for 44 days or till the regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier. The tenure is 44 days with renewal after 44 days for a maximum of one year, including any service rendered as Junior Resident earlier on adhoc/regular basis in any recognized institution. Extension up to one year is subject to satisfactory performance and the work and conduct report from the concerned HOD. Posting of Junior Resident will be made in the interest of the Institute. Selected candidates may have to join immediately, failing which the offer of appointment/Memorandum shall stand cancelled automatically; only those who can join immediately (within 03 days) need to apply. No NOC of any kind for any purpose (passport, visa, etc.) will be given before at least 06 (six) months of service in the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected on the basis of the interview only, and selection will be made strictly on merit. The interview will be held on 2 December 2026 at 12:00 Noon in the concerned department; reporting time is 11:00 AM. The interview may be staggered over a few days if a large number of applications is received. If the interview cannot be completed on the scheduled date, it shall be conducted on the following working day. A waiting list of up to 20% of the advertised vacancies may be prepared, subject to the availability of suitable and eligible candidates; it shall remain valid till 10 days after declaration/publication of the result. If a selected candidate fails to submit acceptance or does not join within the stipulated time, the vacancy may be offered to candidates from the waiting list, strictly in order of merit. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is payable only by Demand Draft issued by a nationalized bank in favour of MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT, G.B. PANT HOSPITAL, payable at New Delhi. Candidates may also deposit the fee in cash with the Cashier at the Accounts Branch of the Institute. The notice does not mention any fee exemption.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GIPMER Junior Resident
content_sections.text: Get the application form (Annexure-I) attached to the notice; it is also available on the Institute's website gbpant.delhigovt.nic.in. Write the department applied for (mention only one), and fill in name in block letters, father's/husband's name, local and permanent address, mobile number/e-mail (must be given), date of birth, present age as on the last date of application, qualifications and category. Affix a photograph in the space provided and sign the declaration. Attach self-attested copies of the certificates listed below. Pay the Rs. 300/- fee by Demand Draft, or in cash at the Accounts Branch. Submit the complete form at 5th Floor, D-Block, Academic Cell, GIPMER on or before 30 November 2026 up to 04.00 P.M. Applications received after the due date shall not be entertained. Report at 11:00 AM on 2 December 2026 in the concerned department with all original documents and their self-attested photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Date of Birth proof Valid DMC registration at the time of joining Internship completion certificate (the form asks for the date of completion) MBBS degree FMGE Pass Certificate (for Foreign Student) Experience certificate, if any Caste/PH/any other relaxation certificate ID proof Attested copies of 10th and 12th certificates (as listed in the application form)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Appointment will be subject to verification of certificates of educational qualifications, age and DMC registration. Any type of discrepancy may invite cancellation of appointment and legal action as per the rules. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained. The decision of the Medical Director will be final; in any legal dispute, the jurisdiction of court will be Delhi/New Delhi only. Candidates should check the Institute website regularly for any further updates. Institute contact printed on the notice: Ph. 91-11-23233001, 23234242; Fax 91-11-23221835; Email [email protected] ; Website www.gbpant.delhigovt.nic.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Resident vacancies are there at GIPMER?
faq.answer: There are 10 provisional vacancies: Cardiology 04, CTVS 01, G.I. Surgery 02, Biochemistry 01 and Psychiatry 02.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GIPMER Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted at 5th Floor, D-Block, Academic Cell, GIPMER on or before 30 November 2026 up to 04.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for GIPMER Junior Resident?
faq.answer: MBBS (equivalent foreign degree only after passing the NBE screening test) with 01 year internship, completed within one year of the last date for submission of application; valid DMC registration is needed at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GIPMER Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years as on 30/11/2026 for General/EWS, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and qualified ex-servicemen and 03 years for OBC (Delhi only).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a GIPMER Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is Pay level 10 (Rs. 56100-Rs. 177500/-) plus usual allowances as per rules/residency rules.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, usual allowances as per rules/residency rules are paid in addition to Pay level 10.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300/- (non-refundable), paid by Demand Draft in favour of MEDICAL SUPERINTENDENT, G.B. PANT HOSPITAL, payable at New Delhi, or in cash at the Institute's Accounts Branch.

faq.question: Q8. How are GIPMER Junior Residents selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of the interview only, strictly on merit; the interview is on 2 December 2026 at 12:00 Noon in the concerned department, with reporting at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q9. Is the GIPMER Junior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely on adhoc basis for 44 days or till regular incumbents join, renewable up to a maximum of one year subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Can current GIPMER Junior Residents apply?
faq.answer: No, Junior Residents presently working in GIPMER are not eligible, and their applications will be treated as cancelled.
